rules.statement: A grandfather can validly accept a donation on behalf of a minor donee, provided the donor has allowed such acceptance.
rules.supporting_quote: "I would therefore hold that the donation to the 2nd plaintiff was a valid one. But there is a further reason why the acceptance in this case should be considered to be good, and it is that the donor had allowed the accep�tance to be made by the grandfather on behalf of his minor child."
